items.name: coldbell cutting
items.eat_message: Faintly metallic. A small resonance moves through the teeth.
items.description: A stem of coldbell flower, harvested near grey stone. The petals have gone. The stem is pale, faintly waxy, and cold to the touch in ways the temperature does not explain.

items.name: Resonant Bone Fragment
items.description: A splinter of something old. The tone in it is audible if you press it against your skull and hold still. Do not hold it near bells.

items.name: moist pebble
items.description: Perpetually damp. Woven round with twine by hands that knew what they were doing. Certain stones feel different when this is on thy person.

items.name: Crow Bile
items.description: A small dark sac. What the crow has processed through it is unclear. The fluid inside is extremely bitter and faintly luminous.
